headline: Approved August 27, 2026 draft minutes; AGEM Properties, LLC hearing at 66-78 Church Street held with no decision recorded.
summary: The board approved the August 27, 2026 draft minutes. It held a hearing for AGEM Properties, LLC, 66-78 Church Street, and a site visit was conducted after the hearing. The Kennedy Brothers Inc. item was removed from the agenda, and the 98 Starr Farm Road LLC item was rescheduled for November 19.
decisions: Approved the August 27, 2026 draft minutes as presented; passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Board Member Eley, seconded by Board Member Fuller, to adopt the August 27, 2026 Draft Minutes as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
